limitations: 20 section observations, 18 unique game URLs, five unique detail inspections. Bounded nonrandom sample; Bloxd.io and Boxity.io occur in both sections. Duplicate exposures are retained without summing metrics.
Homepage US label is not a global ranking; DOM positions are not official ranks.
Hot page monthly title conflicts with last-24-hours introduction; no unified window is inferred.
Missing metrics are null, not zero. Uninspected games do not inherit old metrics or descriptions. Ratings, votes, plays and active users are distinct. Tag counts are directory sizes.

20 cover representations were downloaded locally and fully decoded as AVIF, with file size and SHA-256 verified. HTTP status and response Content-Type cannot be verified through supported cloud-browser APIs; all 20 remain verification_incomplete with null repository paths, hashes and successful fetch metadata. No cover files are eligible for this publication.
Five new Chinese summaries cover six section records through same-run identity reuse; 14 records lack gameplay evidence and retain null descriptions.
Header/body release-date conflicts preserved. Date precision not expanded.
Only cloud browser and GitHub connector used for acquisition. No user computer, hidden API, active gameplay, voting or video downloads. Embedded games may auto-load.
